test_title: PYST 33: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Find out the correct alternative that when filled in the blanks in the same sequence will make the series logically complete.

CN_F F_ZE ILC_ _KFC OJI_
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cbf31fe246e16e853085ce0d7a934ffff2e5d0f5ad9eaa35009ca4aaa5f3408.png] ​

**Given:**

CN_F F_ZE ILC_ _KFC OJI_

**Logic: '3' is added to the positional value of the first and third alphabet and '1' is subtracted from the positional value of the second and third alphabet.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9d7f0f0937942a62e4fae046420e52b30dcba24f7e43ba99e34f040b28b8a2c.png] 

Here, **'****WMDLB'** will complete the series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".

67
